target_customer: Law firms, law schools and legal search firms that pay for recruiting and talent software
problem: Law firm recruiting of students and lateral hires runs on spreadsheets and email, with poor tools for firms, schools and candidates.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription to law firms and law schools, plus a free student side network
product_category: Legal recruiting and talent management software

founders.name: Katherine Allen
education: University of Texas at Austin, BA Plan II
founders.background_notes: Education and story per LiveOak Venture Partners profile; she left UT to work on Flo Recruit full time.

founders.name: Atreya Misra
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder on the LiveOak page; CTO title from a search result summary, not an opened page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Applicant tracking and scheduling workflows with a two-sided student and firm network; standard web software.

defensibility.rationale: Law schools and firms store recruiting data and student profiles in one network, which creates workflow lock-in, though recruiting software is a known category.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move or acquisition found in the sources I opened.

market_need_then: Large law firms run structured summer associate recruiting on campus cycles and the founder saw a gap in tooling while at UT Austin (LiveOak profile); formal demand data not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Built for legal, by people who know it

rebrands.why: Expanded beyond recruiting into a legal talent platform with performance management, per the YC page

branding.community_and_virality: Flo Forward is a job and event board for law students; no source shows brand-level virality.

brand_strength.rationale: A short friendly name that collides with other Flo brands (confusable in search); strength comes from the product network, not the brand.

pivots.to: Broader legal talent platform with performance management

outcome_analysis: Flo Recruit grew slowly and capital-efficiently from a student project to a legal recruiting platform claiming use by most large law firms and law schools. It raised a $1M seed, a reported $4.2M in 2023, and a Series A of about $5M in May 2025 led by LiveOak and Moneta, and renamed to Flo in 2026.
notes: Series A amount of $5M is Crunchbase's figure as relayed by Staffing Industry Analysts; Built In says the amount was not disclosed. The $1M seed has no date and the 2023 $4.2M (YC page news item, plus a search result calling it a seed) may overlap with it; the 2023 stage is other because no opened source labels it. BusinessWire release blocked (403). No dated competitor source found near 2019, so the list is empty. Founded year uncertain: a profile says 2017, Allen worked on it as an undergraduate, YC page says 2019. Misra CTO title not verified on an opened page.
